highlights: Today now shows a weather line when the weather actually calls for something — at most one a day, and nothing at all on the days it has nothing useful to say.
Planting pages now show the heat and weather guidance recorded for that specific variety, and say plainly when there is none recorded rather than leaving the space blank.

Corrected the cabbage care note: it blamed heat for bolting, which is wrong — cabbage bolts from cold. Heat loosens the head and makes it split, so the answer to a hot spell is to cut it, not shade it.
Removing a photo you just added is no longer a trap: the button is a full-size tap target, and you can undo it. Before, a mis-tap destroyed the photo with no way back.
Meta text across the app is darker, so the smaller lines are readable in daylight.
The active tab in the bottom bar is now marked on the icon itself, not only by the colour of a 10px label.
Empty screens now look the same everywhere — seven pages had drifted into seven different designs.
The garden arrival animation now respects your phone's reduce-motion setting, which it previously claimed to do and did not.
